summary: Titan America SA filed a Form 6-K announcing a $0.04 per common share distribution from issue premium for Q2 2026, payable July 7 to June 18 record holders. The board retains discretion over future distributions, subject to shareholder approval. This is a non-dividend capital return utilizing available issue premium, analogous to a US regular cash dividend or distribution from paid-in surplus. No premium, consideration, or structural terms apply. The filing is routine for a foreign private issuer; watch for shareholder approval of future payouts and sustainability of issue premium balance.
